data.title: Coast Copper Increases Proposed Non-Brokered Financing to $1.655 Million
data.description:
An announcement from Coast Copper Corp ( (TSE:COCO) ) is now available.

Coast Copper increased its non-brokered private placement to up to 4,137,500 flow-through units from 2,500,000, raising maximum gross proceeds from $1 million to $1.655 million at $0.40 per unit, citing strong investor demand. Each unit includes one flow-through common share and one warrant exercisable at $0.60 for 24 months after closing.

The proceeds are designated for eligible Canadian exploration expenses qualifying as flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures on the company’s British Columbia projects, with expenses to be incurred before December 31, 2027. The offering remains subject to customary conditions, including TSX Venture Exchange approval, and securities will carry a four-month-and-one-day statutory hold period.

data.title: Kalyon Güneş Reports Latest KLYPV Share Buyback
data.description:
An update from Kalyon Gunes Teknolojileri Uretim Anonim Sirketi ( (TR:KLYPV) ) is now available.

Kalyon Güneş Teknolojileri Üretim A.Ş. launched a share buyback program under a board resolution dated Oct. 19, 2026, covering TRY 5 million nominal value and a maximum payment of TRY 300 million. The stated purpose is to support healthy and stable share-price formation, protect shareholders’ interests and ensure the price reflects operational performance.

Under the program, the company repurchased 81,591 KLYPV Class B shares on Nov. 27, 2026, at an average price of TRY 47.194, within a TRY 46.30–47.70 range. Following buybacks conducted under the Dec. 9, 2025 board resolution, company-held shares reached TRY 5,519,724 nominal value, or 1.20% of share capital.

data.title: Orexo Reports Rights Issue Outcome
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Orexo AB ( (SE:ORX) ).

Orexo reported subscriptions for 218,750,000 new ordinary shares, representing approximately 69.2% of the 316,143,504 shares offered in its rights issue. At SEK 0.80 per share, the subscribed amount corresponds to approximately SEK 175 million before issue costs; DNB Bank subscribed for 88,638,814 shares under its underwriting commitment, utilized to SEK 70.9 million.

The release calculates approximately 86.2% dilution for shareholders who did not participate, excluding Orexo’s class C shares. Post-issue figures list 253,877,056 ordinary shares, up from 35,127,056, and a SEK 89.6 million increase in share capital.

data.title: Malibu Boats Reaches SEC Settlement Over Disclosure Issues
data.description:
Malibu Boats ( (MBUU) ) has provided an update.

Malibu Boats, Inc. reached an agreement in principle with the SEC under which it would pay a $300,000 civil penalty to settle an investigation into statements about channel inventory levels and its relationship with Tommy’s Boats during fiscal years 2023 and 2024.

The contemplated resolution addressed alleged negligent misstatements in reports covering the third quarter of fiscal 2023 through the first quarter of fiscal 2024 and an alleged failure to disclose the deteriorating relationship from December 2023 and/or January 2024 until April 2024; the company said it did not believe the resolution would materially affect its financial position.

data.title: Eightco Holdings Receives Nasdaq Bid Price Compliance Notice
data.description:
Eightco Holdings ( (ORBS) ) has issued an update.

On November 20, 2026, Eightco Holdings Inc. received Nasdaq notification that its common stock no longer met the $1 minimum bid-price requirement after closing below that threshold for 30 consecutive business days from October 8 through November 19, 2026. The notice did not immediately affect trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market; the company received until May 19, 2027, to regain compliance by recording a closing bid of at least $1 for 10 consecutive business days, with a possible additional 180-day period subject to eligibility, while failure could lead to delisting.

data.title: Tombill Mines Appoints Ashley Nadon as Chief Financial Officer
data.description:
An announcement from Tombill Mines Ltd. ( (TSE:TBLL) ) is now available.

Tombill Mines appointed Ashley Nadon as chief financial officer, effective immediately, after a transition period with Athanasios Pythagoras. Nadon replaces Pythagoras, whom the board thanked for his contribution and dedication.

Nadon is a Chartered Professional Accountant who provides financial management, accounting and regulatory compliance services to publicly traded companies. She currently serves as CFO of several TSX Venture Exchange-listed junior resource exploration companies and holds an MBA in Accounting from McMaster University; the appointment remains subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval.

data.title: Tirzepatide and GLP3 Patches Pass U.S. Testing, Receive Production Orders
data.description:
Pangea Natural Food, Inc. ( (TSE:BPC) ) has shared an update.

Pangea Natural Food, Inc. is a publicly traded wellness company focused on advanced peptide formulations and delivery systems, including needle-free transdermal patches. Its announced line covers recovery, metabolic and weight-management categories, with BPC-157 identified as the Recovery Patch and tirzepatide and GLP3 in the metabolic and weight-management category.

The company said tirzepatide and GLP3 passed formal U.S. testing and that it ordered 20,000 units of each from its exclusive U.S. manufacturer; they are the third and fourth patches to reach a commercial production order. BPC-157 is on sale, while all four formulations are tested and manufactured in the United States by one manufacturer producing solely for the company.
